purpose: Open only the frozen R545 FINAL_TEST and test whether the exact L13H8 pending-opener source term transfers delimiter type and whether removing its pairwise delimiter contrast is selectively necessary while preserving its shared baseline.

prior_art.finding: Outcome-blind four-way authority; FINAL_TEST and OOD have not been opened.
FIT and SELECT establish native capability and the complete L13H8 site; FINAL_TEST/OOD stayed closed.
FIT opener payload transferred target behavior, but the old whole-head-normalized control rule returned a source-factor null; do not repeat that selectivity rule.
On a separate fresh triplet authority, natural opener-term swaps and contrast damage were donor-directed; the stronger shared/common separation claim was null.
Raw opener-term zero removal damaged targets and controls alike. The successor must preserve the paired shared mean and remove only contrast.
Shared and contrast removals were approximately additive on the separate triplet authority.
The causal mu/delta effect reaches the output mainly through the residual route; CE also records downstream compensation.
The exact factor's residual contribution folds through RMS normalization, unembedding, and softcap; this does not replace held-out causal validation.

frozen_design.source: The final occurrence of the opener token corresponding to the endpoint's correct closer.
frozen_design.term: t = p_k u_k, the exact post-output-projection L13H8 contribution from that source at the final position.
frozen_design.pair_centered_contrast_removed: Replace t_r by (t_r+t_d)/2. This preserves the pair mean and removes only the recipient-versus-donor contrast.
frozen_design.capability_first: Native is evaluated first. If any registered native cell fails, stop after one forward and do not evaluate replay or a causal arm.

registered_outcomes.pred_a_instrument_live: Native capability, replay exactness, and complete-head target ceiling all pass.
registered_outcomes.pred_b_pair_centered_open_term_held: Under a live instrument, exact opener-term interchange transfers target closer behavior and pair-centered contrast removal selectively damages target margin and CE while controls preserve their answer and remain below the direct selectivity bars.
registered_outcomes.pred_c_transfer_without_selective_necess: Interchange transfers target behavior but midpoint removal or its selectivity gates fail.
registered_outcomes.pred_d_no_heldout_open_term_circuit: The instrument is live but target interchange fails. Preserve this as a scientific null.

interpretation_limits: Pair-centering is an exact counterfactual defined by each frozen base/donor pair, not a globally identified delimiter basis.
This tests held-out lexical/template groups from the existing R545 distribution, not OOD.
No rank, projector, fitting, activation reconstruction, or compression claim is licensed.
